description: This source file defines an asynchronous JavaScript function 'devTryProjectCost' that simulates project cost history data for development purposes. It is used as a helper during local development and is disabled in production environments.

methods.name: devTryProjectCost(projectId)
methods.description: A helper function used in local development to simulate project cost history, disabled in production builds.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Identifier of the project for which cost history is simulated.

methods.return: A Promise resolving to an object containing projectId and historical cost data.
